scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Halo is presented as AI glasses through a fictional-looking story of building, social assistance and piano guidance.
explains_well: The glasses remain the common object across three different human situations, ending with a warm family payoff.
unclear: The film does not distinguish its dramatic visualizations from the actual glasses display or available capabilities.
scenario: Imagine glasses assisting with practical, social and musical tasks.
product_clear_basis: The glasses are named Halo and described as a second brain while a wearer-view interface appears.

lessons.keep: Use a recurring physical object to connect separate use-case stories.
lessons.avoid: Presenting dramatic interface effects without explaining their relationship to the real product.
lessons.open: Actual hardware capabilities, available features, interface provenance and sound remain unverified.
try: For Tin, follow one approved campaign brief across creation, review and publishing, ending on a real customer result.
Compare three imagined benefits with one clearly labeled real task plus a short future-concept section.
